items.title: Head of Retail Technology
items.description: Petra Lindqvist is the Head of Retail Technology at Vellamo Retail Group.

quotes.quote: Petra Lindqvist (Head of Retail Technology)

items.title: SAP Integration Lead
items.description: Marcus Oyelaran is the SAP Integration Lead at Vellamo Retail Group.

quotes.quote: Marcus Oyelaran (SAP Integration Lead)

items.title: Head of E-commerce Operations
items.description: Sandrine Bequet is the Head of E-commerce Operations at Vellamo Retail Group.

quotes.quote: Sandrine Bequet (Head of E-commerce Operations)

items.title: Data & Analytics Manager
items.description: Tomas Reinholt is the Data & Analytics Manager at Vellamo Retail Group.

quotes.quote: Tomas Reinholt (Data & Analytics Manager)

items.title: Vellamo Retail Stores
items.description: Vellamo Retail Group operates 214 stores across Finland, Sweden, and Poland.

quotes.quote: Vellamo runs 214 stores across Finland, Sweden and Poland

items.title: Shopify Plus Storefront
items.description: Vellamo Retail Group operates a Shopify Plus storefront that opened in 2023.

quotes.quote: plus a Shopify Plus storefront that opened in 2023.

items.title: SKU Volume and Seasonality
items.description: Vellamo manages approximately 9,000 SKUs, with about 1,400 being seasonal and changing twice a year.

quotes.quote: Roughly 9,000 SKUs, of which about 1,400 are seasonal and change twice a year.

items.title: SAP S/4HANA
items.description: SAP S/4HANA (on-premises, release 2022) is used for master data, purchasing, finance, and stock ledger.

quotes.quote: SAP S/4HANA (on-premises, release 2022) — master data, purchasing, finance, stock ledger.

items.title: Salesforce Service Cloud
items.description: Salesforce Service Cloud is used for customer service, order enquiries, and returns authorisation.

quotes.quote: Salesforce Service Cloud — customer service, order enquiries, returns authorisation.

items.title: Nordkap Logistics (3PL)
items.description: Nordkap Logistics is a third-party logistics provider operating two warehouses.

quotes.quote: A third-party logistics provider ("Nordkap Logistics") that operates two warehouses and exchanges files over SFTP only.

items.title: Nordkap Logistics SFTP File Exchange
items.description: Nordkap Logistics exchanges files over SFTP only, using CSV and a fixed-width variant for one feed.

quotes.quote: exchanges files over SFTP only. No API. Files are CSV with a fixed-width variant for one feed.

items.title: Snowflake Data Warehouse
items.description: Snowflake data warehouse is used for reporting, currently loaded by SAP extracts and Python scripts.

quotes.quote: Snowflake data warehouse — reporting, currently loaded by a mix of SAP extracts and hand-written Python scripts on a single VM.

items.title: In-house POS System
items.description: An in-house POS system in stores writes sales data to SAP every 15 minutes.

quotes.quote: An in-house POS system in stores, which writes sales to SAP every 15 minutes.

items.title: Replace Point-to-Point Integrations
items.description: The customer aims to replace 31 existing point-to-point integrations, many of which are unowned shell scripts.

quotes.quote: "Every integration is point to point and someone's side project." Petra counted 31 interfaces, of which 9 are scheduled shell scripts nobody owns.

items.title: Inventory Freshness on Shopify
items.description: Inventory displayed on Shopify is currently up to 6 hours stale, leading to overselling.

quotes.quote: Inventory shown on Shopify is up to 6 hours stale. During the November peak they oversold about 2,300 orders and had to cancel them manually.

items.impact_if_wrong: Continued overselling and manual cancellations.

items.title: Reduce Overselling and Manual Cancellations
items.description: The customer experienced overselling of approximately 2,300 orders during peak season due to stale inventory, requiring manual cancellations.

quotes.quote: During the November peak they oversold about 2,300 orders and had to cancel them manually.

items.title: Consistent Order Status in Salesforce
items.description: Order status in Salesforce currently does not match 3PL dispatch files, requiring agents to use multiple systems.

quotes.quote: Order status in Salesforce does not match the 3PL's dispatch files, so agents open SAP and the 3PL portal in separate tabs.

items.title: Customer Service Average Handle Time
items.description: The customer aims to reduce the average handle time for order enquiries from 8 minutes to under 5 minutes.

quotes.quote: Average handle time is 8 minutes; they want under 5.

items.title: Customer Service Agents
items.description: Customer service agents handle order enquiries and returns authorization.

quotes.quote: Order status in Salesforce does not match the 3PL's dispatch files, so agents open SAP and the 3PL portal in separate tabs.

items.title: Shopify Orders to SAP S/4HANA
items.description: Shopify orders must be captured and sent to SAP S/4HANA as sales orders.

quotes.quote: Shopify orders to SAP S/4HANA as sales orders.

items.impact_if_wrong: Orders are not processed in SAP.

items.title: Order Capture Latency
items.description: The target end-to-end latency for order capture from Shopify to SAP S/4HANA is under 2 minutes.

quotes.quote: Target under 2 minutes end to end.

items.impact_if_wrong: Orders are not processed in SAP in a timely manner.

items.title: Order Volume Handling
items.description: The system must handle approximately 11,000 orders a day, with a peak of 68,000 orders on Black Friday.

quotes.quote: Roughly 11,000 orders a day, peak 68,000 on Black Friday (to confirm — Sandrine quoted from memory).

items.impact_if_wrong: System failure or performance degradation during peak periods.

items.title: Order Release to Nordkap Logistics
items.description: Batched order files must be sent to Nordkap Logistics over SFTP.

quotes.quote: batched file to Nordkap over SFTP

items.impact_if_wrong: Orders are not fulfilled by the 3PL.

items.title: Nordkap Logistics File Drop Schedule
items.description: Nordkap Logistics requires four daily file drops at 06:00, 11:00, 15:00, and 19:00 CET, and will not change this schedule before 2027.

quotes.quote: currently four drops a day at 06:00, 11:00, 15:00 and 19:00 CET. Nordkap will not change the schedule before 2027.

items.impact_if_wrong: Inability to integrate with Nordkap Logistics.

items.title: Nordkap Dispatch and Tracking Confirmations
items.description: The system must receive dispatch and tracking files from Nordkap Logistics.

quotes.quote: Nordkap returns a dispatch file and a tracking file.

items.impact_if_wrong: Lack of visibility into order fulfillment status.

items.title: Sequence Number Gap Detection for Nordkap Files
items.description: The system must detect gaps in sequence numbers within Nordkap dispatch and tracking files, as gaps have gone unnoticed for days.

quotes.quote: File names include a sequence number; gaps have gone unnoticed for days.

items.impact_if_wrong: Missing dispatch or tracking information.

items.title: Inventory Position to Shopify and POS
items.description: Near-real-time inventory availability from SAP and the 3PL must be provided to Shopify and the in-house POS system.

quotes.quote: near-real-time availability from SAP and the 3PL to Shopify and to the POS.

items.impact_if_wrong: Continued inventory inaccuracies and overselling.

items.title: Inventory Position Refresh Rate
items.description: The target refresh rate for inventory position updates is under 5 minutes.

quotes.quote: Target refresh under 5 minutes.

items.impact_if_wrong: Stale inventory data leading to business issues.

items.title: Available-to-Promise (ATP) Calculation
items.description: The system needs an available-to-promise calculation that subtracts reserved stock.

quotes.quote: Needs an available-to-promise calculation that subtracts reserved stock (to confirm which system owns the reservation).

items.impact_if_wrong: Inaccurate inventory availability calculations.

items.title: Automated Returns Process
items.description: The returns process, currently entirely manual, needs to be automated across Salesforce, 3PL, and SAP.

quotes.quote: Salesforce creates a return authorisation, 3PL receives the goods, SAP posts the credit. Three systems, currently entirely manual.

items.impact_if_wrong: Continued manual effort and delays in returns processing.

items.title: Customer and Order Data to Snowflake (Nightly)
items.description: Customer and order data must be sent nightly to the Snowflake data warehouse.

quotes.quote: Customer and order data to Snowflake: nightly

items.impact_if_wrong: Snowflake data is not up-to-date for reporting.

items.title: Intraday Order Events Feed to Snowflake
items.description: An intraday order-events feed is required for the operations dashboard in Snowflake.

quotes.quote: plus an intraday order-events feed for the operations dashboard.

items.impact_if_wrong: Operations dashboard lacks real-time order event data.

items.title: Product Master from SAP to Shopify and Salesforce
items.description: Product master data, including price and tax class, must be sent from SAP to Shopify and Salesforce.

quotes.quote: Product master out of SAP to Shopify and Salesforce, including price and tax class.

items.impact_if_wrong: Inconsistent product information across systems.

items.title: Product Master Load Frequency
items.description: Product master data (approx. 9,000 SKUs) requires a full load nightly and deltas during the day.

quotes.quote: Roughly 9,000 SKUs, full load nightly, deltas during the day.

items.impact_if_wrong: Stale product data in Shopify and Salesforce.

items.title: Finance Postings from Payment Provider to SAP
items.description: Daily settlement files from the payment provider must be reconciled against Shopify orders and posted to SAP.

quotes.quote: daily settlement file from the payment provider reconciled against Shopify orders and posted to SAP.

items.impact_if_wrong: Inaccurate financial records in SAP.

items.title: Interface Retry with Backoff
items.description: Every interface needs a retry mechanism with backoff.

quotes.quote: Every interface needs retry with backoff

items.impact_if_wrong: Transient failures lead to data loss or inconsistencies.

items.title: Interface Dead-Letter Destination
items.description: Every interface needs a dead-letter destination for failed messages.

quotes.quote: a dead-letter destination

items.impact_if_wrong: Lost messages and inability to recover from failures.

items.title: Operator View for Failed Interfaces
items.description: An operator view is required to see failed interfaces and allow operators to replay messages.

quotes.quote: an operator view. Marcus was explicit: "we need to see what failed and replay it ourselves."

items.impact_if_wrong: Operators cannot manage or recover from integration failures.

items.title: Operators
items.description: Operators need to view and replay failed integration messages.

quotes.quote: an operator view. Marcus was explicit: "we need to see what failed and replay it ourselves."

items.title: Daily Three-Way Reconciliation
items.description: Daily reconciliation is required between Shopify orders, SAP sales orders, and 3PL dispatches.

quotes.quote: Daily reconciliation between Shopify orders, SAP sales orders and 3PL dispatches, with a break report. This was the single most requested item on the call.

items.impact_if_wrong: Inconsistencies between systems remain undetected.

items.title: Reconciliation Break Report
items.description: A break report must be generated as part of the daily reconciliation process.

quotes.quote: with a break report. This was the single most requested item on the call.

items.impact_if_wrong: Inability to identify and address reconciliation discrepancies.

items.title: File Integration Duplicate Detection
items.description: File integrations need duplicate detection.

quotes.quote: File integrations need duplicate detection

items.impact_if_wrong: Duplicate processing of files leading to data inconsistencies.

items.title: File Integration Sequence-Gap Detection
items.description: File integrations need sequence-gap detection.

quotes.quote: and sequence-gap detection.

items.impact_if_wrong: Missing files or out-of-order processing leading to data inconsistencies.

items.title: Peak Sizing for Black Friday
items.description: The system must be sized to handle Black Friday week, which sees 6x normal order volume.

quotes.quote: Peak sizing: Black Friday week is 6x normal order volume.

items.impact_if_wrong: System failure or performance degradation during peak periods.

items.title: Message Payloads Retention
items.description: Message payloads must be retained for 90 days.

quotes.quote: Retention: message payloads 90 days

items.title: Reconciliation Results Retention
items.description: Reconciliation results must be retained for 7 years.

quotes.quote: reconciliation results 7 years (Tomas, to confirm with finance).

items.title: GDPR Compliance for Personal Data
items.description: Personal data in orders is in scope of GDPR, with no special-category data involved.

quotes.quote: Personal data in orders is in scope of GDPR. No special-category data.

items.title: PCI Out of Scope
items.description: PCI compliance is out of scope because card data stays with the payment provider.

quotes.quote: PCI is out of scope because card data stays with the payment provider (to confirm with their security team).

items.title: Monitoring Integration with Grafana
items.description: Monitoring data must feed their existing Grafana instance if possible.

quotes.quote: Monitoring must feed their existing Grafana instance if possible.

items.impact_if_wrong: Operators cannot use their preferred monitoring tool.

items.title: AWS Platform Preference
items.description: AWS is the confirmed technology platform.

quotes.quote: AWS is confirmed.

items.title: AWS Managed Services Preference
items.description: The customer has a stated preference for managed services over anything they have to patch.

quotes.quote: a stated preference for managed services over anything they have to patch.

items.title: No Self-Managed Kafka Cluster
items.description: The customer explicitly stated they do not want to run their own Kafka cluster.

quotes.quote: Petra said "no Kafka cluster we have to run ourselves."

items.title: AWS Region Preference
items.description: The primary AWS region is eu-north-1, with eu-west-1 considered for services not available in Stockholm.

quotes.quote: Region: eu-north-1, with eu-west-1 mentioned for services not available in Stockholm.

items.title: No iPaaS Budget
items.description: The customer is open to an iPaaS product but has not budgeted for licenses.

quotes.quote: They are open to an iPaaS product but have not budgeted for licences

items.title: AWS Managed Services Build Assumption
items.description: A build on AWS managed services is the working assumption due to the lack of iPaaS budget.

quotes.quote: so a build on AWS managed services is the working assumption.

items.title: Inventory Accuracy Deadline
items.description: Inventory accuracy must be fixed before the 2026 peak.

quotes.quote: Hard requirement: inventory accuracy fixed before the 2026 peak.

items.impact_if_wrong: Continued business losses due to overselling during peak season.

items.title: Code Freeze Date
items.description: A code freeze is required by November 1, 2026.

quotes.quote: Code freeze 1 November 2026.

items.title: Nordkap Contract Renewal
items.description: Nordkap's contract renewal is in mid-2027, at which point an API may become available.

quotes.quote: Nordkap contract renewal is in mid-2027; an API may become available then

items.title: Future Nordkap API Extensibility
items.description: File integrations with Nordkap should be built to not block a later switch to an API.

quotes.quote: so file integrations should not be built in a way that blocks a later switch.

items.impact_if_wrong: Significant rework required if Nordkap provides an API.

items.title: Customer Team Availability
items.description: The customer team can provide one SAP integration developer half-time and one analyst full-time.

quotes.quote: Their team can provide one SAP integration developer half time and one analyst full time.

items.title: Internal Business Case Contingency
items.description: The internal business case includes a 15% contingency, which may increase due to the 3PL dependency.

quotes.quote: Contingency in their internal business case is 15%. Petra noted the steering group may push this up given the 3PL dependency.

items.title: 3PL Dependency
items.description: The project has a dependency on the 3PL (Nordkap Logistics), which may affect the budget contingency.

quotes.quote: given the 3PL dependency.
